description: Set the banner theme preset and/or individual CSS custom properties. All or nothing: one invalid name or value rejects the whole request (400, names in data.invalid). Returns { saved: true }.

preset.description: Theme preset; an unknown preset renders as default

vars.description: --cvrt-consent-* overrides (bg, fg, accent, radius, font, shadow, link, title, backdrop). REPLACES the stored overrides as a whole: send every override you want to keep, {} clears them. Values are plain CSS (no ; { } < \ or comments, max 200 chars).

name: legal_put_theme
